soundness: the deleted store writes the word below the stack pointer that only the callee's ret reads; call 1f;pop excluded (destination == stored address) and pinned by the stage and CLI tests; callpopret lifts a callee that pops its return address as a BRANCH, so no CALL to match; an alloca frame is not runnable C in either arm, so the round trip is the statement set (CLI test) and the whole-corpus classification
